stories.title: OpenAI doubles down on decision to fire three AI safety researchers
stories.simple_summary: OpenAI fired three researchers who work on AI safety. The company says they broke rules about how to handle secret information.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to people working in AI companies. For ordinary business owners and retirees, there's nothing you need to do right now.

stories.title: Firmus: Nvidia-backed data centre firm scraps IPO as AI valuation concerns deepen
stories.simple_summary: A company backed by Nvidia that runs computer servers decided not to go public and sell shares to investors. Investors are worried that AI companies might not be worth as much money as people thought.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors. There's nothing you need to do.

stories.title: Is this the ‘mathocalypse’? Why OpenAI’s latest results dump has left mathematicians in shock
stories.simple_summary: OpenAI's latest AI tool is surprisingly good at solving math problems. Mathematicians are shocked by what it can do.
stories.why_it_matters: This is interesting news for education and engineering, but doesn't immediately affect your daily life or small business.

stories.title: ‘Breathtaking,’ ‘Devastating’: Mathematics Reels After New OpenAI Release
stories.simple_summary: OpenAI released something new that can do math better than expected. Math experts are surprised and concerned about what this means.
stories.why_it_matters: This is interesting for people in science and education, but there's nothing most ordinary people need to act on right now.

stories.title: Modi wants India to power the AI age. Residents are pushing back
stories.simple_summary: The Prime Minister of India wants India to become a big player in AI technology. But some regular people living there are worried about what that will mean for them.
stories.why_it_matters: This is news about India's technology plans. It doesn't directly affect people in other countries unless they have business ties there.

stories.title: Fired OpenAI employees raise concerns over AI safety, monitoring
stories.simple_summary: Researchers that OpenAI fired are saying they weren't doing anything wrong. They're warning that people at the company might now be afraid to speak up about AI safety problems.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to AI industry workers. For most people, there's nothing you need to do.

stories.title: Anthropic launches free AI security scans for open-source projects
stories.simple_summary: A company called Anthropic is offering free security checks for software projects that are shared publicly online. They'll look for problems that hackers could take advantage of.
stories.why_it_matters: This is mainly helpful for software developers and IT people. If you run a small business that uses software, this doesn't directly affect you.

stories.title: Pretend you’re sitting at Elizabeth Holmes’ desk on this weirdly detailed website
stories.simple_summary: Someone created a website where you can look through thousands of emails and documents from Elizabeth Holmes' trial. It's set up like her actual desk so you can explore what was there.
stories.why_it_matters: This is interesting history and trivia, but it has nothing to do with AI or anything affecting your life.

stories.title: Anthropic Moves Us One Step Closer to Making ‘Clanker’ a Slur
stories.simple_summary: Anthropic released something related to robots or AI, and the headline suggests it might be controversial in some way, but the details aren't clear from the headline alone.
stories.why_it_matters: Without more information, it's hard to say if this matters. It's probably most relevant to tech workers.

stories.title: California is trying to shut down robot vs. human cage matches
stories.simple_summary: California's athletic commission told a company to stop holding fights between humans and robots. They say these fights need to follow the same rules as regular boxing matches.
stories.why_it_matters: This is interesting entertainment news, but unless you're running a robot fighting company, it doesn't affect your life.

stories.title: Fired OpenAI safety researchers dispute misconduct claims, warn of chilling effect
stories.simple_summary: The three fired OpenAI researchers say they did nothing wrong and are warning that firing them might make other workers scared to report safety problems.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to AI industry workers. For most people, there's nothing you need to do.

stories.title: Trump: Anyone saying "AI" is "THE ENEMY!" The White House uses it
stories.simple_summary: The headline suggests Trump criticized AI, but then notes that the White House itself uses AI. The details aren't clear from just the headline.
stories.why_it_matters: This is about politics and government policy. It's hard to say what it really means without more information.
